cd /workspace/project && timeout 200 python3 - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request,collections
r=urllib.request.Request("https://api.openuncensored.com/v1/models",headers={"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0"})
with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=40) as x: d=json.load(x)
print("total model:",len(d["data"]))
prov=collections.Counter()
for m in d["data"]:
    for p in m.get("providers",[]) or []:
        prov[p.get("name")]+=1
print("\n=== provider (jumlah model) ===")
for k,v in prov.most_common(): print(f"  {v:4}  {k}")
PY
